AKTA KASTAM 1967
PERINTAH Duti KASTAM 1978

P.U. (A) 243.

Papa menjalankan kuasa-kuasa yang diberi oleh Perintah Duti Kastam
1978, Ketua Pengarah Kastam mentakrifkan istilah-istilah "completely
knocked down" dan "completely built-up" mengenai motosikal,
autosikal dan basikal yang dipasangkan dengan motor tambahan yang
terdapat di ruangan 2 bersetentangan dengan nombor-nombor kepala
87.09 200, 87.09 910, 87.09 921 dan 87.09 929 dalam Jadual Pertama
kepada Perintah Duti Kastam 1978, seperti di dalam Jadual bersama ini.

Takrif "completely knocked down" dan "completely built-up" seperti
di dalam Jadual bersama ini hendaklah mula berkuatkuasa pada
lhb September 1978.

P.U. (A) 247 yang disiarkan pada 14hb Ogos 1975 adalah dibatalkan.

CUSTOMS ACT 1967
Customs DuTIES ORDER 1978

IN exercise of the powers conferred by the Customs Duties Order 1978,
the Director-General of Customs défines the terms "completely knocked
down" and "completely built-up" in respect of motor-cycles, autocycles
and cycles fitted with an auxiliary motor, appearing in column 2 against
the heading numbers 87.09 200, 87.09 910, 87.09 921 and 87.09 929
in the First Schedule to the Customs Duties Order 1978, as in the
Schedule hereto.

This definition of "completely knocked down" and "‘completely built-
